purpose: A song full of nonsense words sounds like a cousin of Deadfish. I want to see if it is.

pages.title: Mairzy Doates
pages.reaction: A racehorse named after a novelty nonsense song, which is a fun bit of cover for a Deadfish cousin hunt, but there is no code here at all, just a horse. The Japan Cup story is great: a mare beating the nation's best with the sprinklers pointed at the flowerbeds. I got a laugh from that. Nothing so far looks …

pages.title: Japan Cup
pages.reaction: A horse race page. Nothing nonsense-worded here, no Deadfish cousin. The track quirks are the closest thing: a sharp rise, a long homestretch. Wrong trip for my question, but the Japan Cup history is oddly gripping. I'll take one link and stop reading.

pages.title: Japan Cup (cycling)
pages.reaction: A cycling results table with a dead template dump at the top. No nonsense words, no Deadfish cousin in sight. Mildly sad the song idea didn't show up here; the only nonsense is the wiki markup itself.

pages.title: Lotto–Intermarché
pages.reaction: A cycling team page, which is about as far from a song full of nonsense words as a page can get. Nothing here sounds like Deadfish, so the trip's question goes unanswered. Mildly interesting that the team has been renamed more often than I have.
